correctness.rationale: A labelled 5x5 0–1 table with all row/column degrees 2 is a 2-regular bipartite graph of ten vertices, hence support type C10 or C4⊔C6. Independent generation as unions of disjoint permutation matchings gives exactly 2040 states (1440 and 600). A separately written checker enumerated precisely the 26100 legal rectangular switches, verifies adjacency by row/column margin, and performs complete BFS from one representative of each support orbit. Shells are (1,25,230,810,831,141,2) and (1,27,242,840,810,120,0); S5×S5 transitivity extends these exact BFS distributions to every state. It confirms exactly two antipodes of the canonical C10 representative, given by two cyclic column shifts, and produces distance pair histogram (26100,238200,835200,841320,137520,1440). This exhaustive FINITE proof establishes radius 5 and diameter 6; does not extrapolate to all n.

evidence: Erdős et al Theorem 4.1 gives a general bipartite bound of 8 here, not sharp 6. Earlier lumping formula yields degree 25/27 and state counts, but no shortest paths in a fixed orbit.
